smell_validity.evidence: The injected helpers genuinely sit on types they barely touch: several have receivers their bodies never read, instead assembling data of another object passed as a parameter, so ownership of naming rules, error rendering, and lookup logic is visibly misplaced. One plugin helper legitimately uses its receiver's state, drawing the boundary from healthy design, though the fault's consequence is moderate rather than central.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Because rule logic now lives on a type that merely forwards it, changes to message naming, nesting expansion, or error-payload assembly must cross an object boundary and be traced between layers; widening the indexing walk's parameter also obscures what the data-holding type owns. Removal makes future work safer as well as shorter, though the affected scope is small.

development_plausibility.evidence: The change reads like ordinary readability housekeeping: bodies moved as-is, coherent comments rationalizing the convenient receiver, and terminology and style matching the surrounding generator and error code. The wrong-object placement reads as a believable compromise, though the same extraction shape repeated across three components leaves a faintly regular, task-like pattern.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The prompt pins the problem precisely, names the three affected areas, forbids stopping early, forwarding shims, dead helpers, and rename-only moves, and sets exact preservation boundaries: byte-identical error bodies and generated sources, tests, and public API. By licensing kept split-attention logic with a note, it decisively blocks wrong direction, partial cleanup, and over-eager redesign.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Four distinct purposes carry the problem - error payload assembly, name derivation, dependency lookup, and Go name formatting - and at least two need different decisions: the error data is reachable only through an interface, so the fix cannot be a simple method move, unlike the concrete definition type, while the formatting helper's receiver genuinely contributes state.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt names the three areas but not the individual helpers, so the solver must read each area and match the misplaced-receiver pattern; classification stays local because each body shows which side owns the data. Registry-to-plugin flow exists, but no aliases, callbacks, or configuration complicate the search; one borderline helper must be kept rather than repaired.

repair_coordination.evidence: Mostly independent moves with mechanical caller updates: restoring ownership methods lets callers reconnect to the pre-existing arrangement, though the indexing walk's parameter must be settled consistently with which helpers move. No cross-location shared rule breaks if one site is repaired alone, since the error path, registry, and plugin components are independent.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: One uniform rule - relocate each helper onto the type it walks - cleanly covers the name-derivation, nesting-expansion, and dependency-lookup sites, about three of five locations. It fails on the payload fill, whose walked type is an interface where a method move is impossible, and misfires on the formatting helper, landing at the 60 percent threshold.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Wrong moves surface as ordinary, comparable bad output: altered error bodies change the exact JSON that existing error tests assert, and broken type names or import lists stop generated code from compiling. No evidence shows an unchecked hidden failure path; special states such as publicly-imported protos are only speculative here.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
